findings.description: Color index 0 is skipped because the new condition tests truthiness. The same regression affects background colors at line 684.
findings.rationale: Calling style("text", fg=0) or style("text", bg=0) requests the valid ANSI palette index 0 (black). Since 0 is false, the corresponding escape sequence is omitted, so the text retains the terminal's current color instead of using black.

findings.description: Numeric colors are no longer range-checked before generating ANSI sequences, including RGB components.
findings.rationale: Calling style("text", fg=256) or style("text", fg=(256, 0, 0)) now emits an out-of-range ANSI color sequence instead of raising ValueError. Invalid color configuration therefore passes silently into output, where the terminal may ignore or misrender the requested color.
